nodes.name: GitHub Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives GitHub push events. Configure in GitHub repo Settings > Webhooks.

nodes.name: Filter Task Files
nodes.notes: Filters pushed files to TASKS/*.md only. Returns array of task file paths.

nodes.name: Gate 1 — Sanitize
nodes.notes: Blocks prompt injection patterns. Throws error if found — triggers error branch.

nodes.name: Task Analyzer Agent
nodes.notes: Calls Claude API. Uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var — never hardcode.

nodes.name: Gate 2 — Schema Validate
nodes.notes: Validates agent output matches SpecOutputSchema. Throws if path is outside pending-review/.

nodes.name: Write Audit Trail
nodes.notes: Writes to Supabase audit table. SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY stays server-side only — never in frontend.

nodes.name: Format SPEC Markdown
nodes.notes: Converts JSON spec to Obsidian-formatted Markdown with YAML frontmatter.

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Catches errors from Gate 1, Agent, or Gate 2. Logs to Supabase with status: error.

env_vars_required: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — server-side only, never expose in frontend
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY — server-side only, never expose in frontend
github_webhook_setup: 1. Go to your vault repo on GitHub
5. Secret: generate with `openssl rand -hex 32` and store as N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET
